description: Email check: validates the address format, confirms the domain exists and accepts mail (MX), and flags disposable providers, role accounts (info@, support@), and free providers. Returns deliverable_likely, risky, undeliverable, or invalid with a reason. No message is sent. Useful for cleaning sign-up lists and lead data before outreach. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
name: check_email
title: Email address check
